name: DownloadFile
description: Downloads a file from a SharePoint document library using Microsoft Graph and returns its content and metadata.
author: @rahmat

fields.name: __CredentialId__M365
fields.label: M365 Credential
fields.description: Select the Microsoft 365 credential used to authenticate the SharePoint request.

fields.name: FilePath
fields.label: File Path
fields.description: The full SharePoint URL of the file you want to download. For example: /sites/YourSite/Shared Documents/YourFile.txt

fields.name: Result
fields.label: Result
fields.description: The result of the file download operation, including the file content (Base64 encoded), metadata, and any error messages.
